# Orders analytics project instructions

Read [the project conventions](../orders-analytics/.github/copilot-instructions.md) before answering project questions or changing code. The project lives in `orders-analytics/`; run its commands from that folder or the named subfolder.

Lab guides and reference answers are outside the project. Use project files to complete a learner's task; do not search sibling lab folders, `progress/`, `instructor/` or `solved/` for answers.
